name: buffed-github
description: Buffs for GitHub: small improvements to its interface.

scripts.lint: npm run build && web-ext lint --source-dir dist
scripts.sign: npm run typecheck && npm run build && web-ext sign --source-dir dist --channel unlisted
scripts.source-zip: mkdir -p web-ext-artifacts && git archive --format zip --output web-ext-artifacts/source.zip HEAD
